title: Breastfeeding support interventions or referrals during pregnancy and after birth

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends providing interventions or referrals, during pregnancy and after birth, to support breastfeeding.

action: Provide interventions or referrals, during pregnancy and after birth, to support breastfeeding.

any.note: Measurement-year scoping of pregnancy is a modeling choice; the text gives no timing.
The text does not define the length of the postpartum period.
